U.S. equity futures remained under pressure, with Nasdaq 100 futures declining 0.38%, S&P 500 futures dropping 0.34%, and Dow futures easing 0.21%.
In commodities, WTI crude oil slipped below $92 per barrel, while spot gold held under $4,300 per ounce.
South Korea’s KOSPI rose 0.90% as the South Korean won weakened to around 1,370 per dollar.
